Add @N3mezis and @BBuf as owners of the paged experts runtime directory and dedicated kernel implementation/wrapper, using just two CODEOWNERS rules.

Validated both patterns against current main: they cover nine core source files and exclude docs and tests.

Before merging, a repository admin needs to grant @N3mezis write access so GitHub can recognize him as a code owner.
